english: Place beside an end of the step deck, not on a step. Wire it to a generator or battery. Powered means the belt runs. Activate to reverse direction. Register it with the Escalator Setup Tool.
Not part of any escalator. Hold the Escalator Setup Tool, aim here, hold E, Register Drive.
Hold it, aim at a half-block step, hold E. New Escalator, Set End 1 and Set End 2 on opposite corners of the step deck, Register Drive. Sides you build stay put.
